observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 12, 2026): file_pull needs can_view and can_access_files; config_push needs can_edit, which does not include reading files, so the two modes need separate grants; a restricted project behaves the same for identities with grants there; every identity can read identities/current with its effective permissions, so the SEC-16 warning is feasible. Evidence: runs 20261012T200415Z-g-l9-*.
